markets.question: Mike Evans Receiving Yards Escalator · Mike Evans
markets.displayTitle: Mike Evans Receiving Yards Escalator · Mike Evans
markets.rules:
If Each Yes contract pays per receiving yards by Mike Evans in the Minnesota vs San Francisco Pro Football game originally scheduled for Nov 22, 2026. Each 10 receiving yards increase the payout by the following schedule: 0–9 yards, $0.0000; 10–19, $0.0001; 20–29, $0.0010; 30–39, $0.0033; 40–49, $0.0080; 50–59, $0.0156; 60–69, $0.0270; 70–79, $0.0428; 80–89, $0.0640; 90–99, $0.0911; 100–109, $0.1250; 110–119, $0.1663; 120–129, $0.2160; 130–139, $0.2746; 140–149, $0.3430; 150–159, $0.4218; 160–169, $0.5120; 170–179, $0.6141; 180–189, $0.7290; 190–199, $0.8573; and 200 or more, $1.0000. Each No contract pays $1.00 minus the Yes payout. Yes pays out at most $1.00. Then the market resolves to Yes.
This is a scalar market. The Yes payout per contract shown above follows this calculation:
Payout Formula = floor(10000 x (y / 200)^3) / 10000
y = min(200, max(0, 10 x floor(s / 10)))
s = official receiving yards

The No payout is $1.00 minus the Yes payout. Negative receiving yard totals pay Yes $0.00.
